verdict.line: You lose if you trade into Purge range before 6; you win if you survive to Trinity Force and he's used Disdain.

brief.thesis: Urgot outranges Jax at every level before Jax closes the gap, and his W (Purge) punishes exactly the extended-auto trades Jax wants to make. The 47.7% head-to-head over 128 games reflects a lane where Urgot has priority and the solo-kill edge, but Jax's E (Counter Strike) is a hard answer to Purge if timed on the dodge window, not the damage window.

theirWindow.what: He can walk you down, land E (Disdain) to stop you in place, then unload W (Purge) point-blank while you're slowed from Q (Corrosive Charge). Do not stand still to trade autos here — back off and wait.

yourWindow.what: Use Q (Leap Strike) onto him the instant Disdain is clearly on cooldown (he just used it to farm a wave or missed it on you). Combine with W (Empower) on the leap for the bonus damage and all-in with R (Relentless Assault) active before he can reset range.

start.why: 47.1% win rate over 68 games and the higher pick rate (42.8%) — the extra sustain and early trade tankiness matter against a lane where Urgot gets free pokes with Q (Corrosive Charge) and Purge before you can close.

boots.why: 75.3% pick rate and 44.5% win rate over 110 games — the flat damage reduction blunts his auto-reliant Purge (W) and basic attack chip damage better than magic resist boots would.

core.why: 53.8% win rate over 13 games in the top path — the burst of damage and movement speed is what lets Jax actually close the gap Urgot opens with his range.
Pairs with Trinity Force in the most-played path (53.8% over 13 games) — gives healing on crits so all-ins after a landed E (Counter Strike) stun are sustained.
16.1% pick rate in the top build path — lets you dive in on cooldowns of Disdain (E) without eating his R (Fear Beyond Death) execute if the fight goes long.

situational.when: he is building toward a long trade war and you need the bleed-over sustain to win extended fights (71.4% win rate over 7 games in that path)
he is stacking health and you need the percent-health damage to keep trades relevant
his team has heavy crowd control beyond Disdain (E) that you need tenacity against

runes.keystoneWhy: 58.8% win rate on this page (10.6% pick) — the proc gives Jax both the extra health and the bonus damage on first contact that a short-range poke matchup needs, turning a landed auto into real lane sustain.

summoners.why: 59.6% pick rate for Flash+Teleport, the most-run combo in this matchup — Teleport lets you reset after losing early trades to Purge (W) without bleeding global gold, since this is a lane you're expected to survive rather than win outright before 6.

playing.title: Don't trade before Disdain is tracked
playing.detail: Never walk up for an auto trade without knowing where Urgot's E (Disdain, cooldown 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) is. If it's up, he can stop your approach and follow with Purge (W) at point-blank range.

playing.title: Save E for the Purge channel
playing.detail: E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks, so use it the moment he starts channeling Purge (W), not preemptively. A well-timed Counter Strike negates the entire Purge trade and stuns him for the follow-up.

playing.title: Last-hit under turret early
playing.detail: Levels 1-5, Corrosive Charge (Q, 800 range) and auto pokes will out-damage your trades. Prioritize CS from range rather than contesting space.

playing.title: All-in only after Trinity Force
playing.detail: Your power spike is the Trinity Force completion, not a level. Once it's up, look for all-ins whenever Disdain (E) is down — Leap Strike (Q) in, Empower (W) the leap, Counter Strike (E) if he tries to Purge back.

playing.title: Use Teleport to reset bad trades
playing.detail: If you lose the early exchanges to Purge, recall and Teleport back rather than fighting from a health deficit — this matchup is winnable from full resources even if lane phase goes even or slightly behind.

playing.title: Respect the execute past 6
playing.detail: Once Urgot hits level 6, don't dive all-in under 40% health in his face — R (Fear Beyond Death, 2500 range) can execute you if he connects and you're below his threshold.

playing.title: Walk up only on cooldown windows
playing.detail: Track Corrosive Charge (Q, 10-8s cooldown) and Purge (W, 12-0s cooldown) — approach to trade only when both are down, since either alone resets the fight in his favor.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoners reflect measured games on the current patch (16.20.1) from OP.GG; the matchup reading — windows, trade patterns, and ability timing — is my own analysis of the kit interactions, not sourced from the data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Urgot closing in with Disdain (E). Be careful of his Purge (W) when he closes in! Use Counter Strike [E] to block his Purge (W).
